identificationModule.briefTitle: A Trial of TQB2868 Plus Platinum-based Chemotherapy With or Without Bevacizumab in the First-line Treatment of Persistent, Recurrent, or Metastatic Cervical Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: TQB2868 Plus Platinum-based Chemotherapy With or Without Bevacizumab in the First-line Treatment of Persistent, Recurrent, or Metastatic Cervical Cancer: a Single-arm, Open-label Phase Ⅱ Study

statusModule.whyStopped: Slow progress in development, the sponsor decided to withdraw and no longer proceed.

leadSponsor.name: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study used a single-arm, open phase II multicenter trial design. All eligible subjects received TQB2868 plus platinum-based chemotherapy with or without bevacizumab. A total of 39 subjects will be enrolled.

armGroups.label: TQB2868 injection + Paclitaxel injection + Cisplatin/Carboplatin injection ± Bevacizumab injection
armGroups.description: TQB2868 injection + paclitaxel injection + cisplatin/carboplatin injection ± bevacizumab injection, 3 weeks (21 days) as a treatment cycle.

interventions.name: TQB2868 injection
interventions.description: TQB2868 injection is an anti-programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1)/ transforming growth factor-β (TGF-β) dual-function fusion protein.
armGroupLabels: TQB2868 injection + Paclitaxel injection + Cisplatin/Carboplatin injection ± Bevacizumab injection

interventions.name: Paclitaxel injection
interventions.description: Paclitaxel injection prevents depolymerization of microtubules, inhibits mitosis, and hinders normal cell division.
armGroupLabels: TQB2868 injection + Paclitaxel injection + Cisplatin/Carboplatin injection ± Bevacizumab injection

interventions.name: Cisplatin injection
interventions.description: Cisplatin injection can inhibit the DNA replication process of cancer cells
armGroupLabels: TQB2868 injection + Paclitaxel injection + Cisplatin/Carboplatin injection ± Bevacizumab injection

interventions.name: Carboplatin injection
interventions.description: Carboplatin injection acts directly on DNA, thus inhibiting the vigorous division of tumor cells.
armGroupLabels: TQB2868 injection + Paclitaxel injection + Cisplatin/Carboplatin injection ± Bevacizumab injection

interventions.name: Bevacizumab injection
interventions.description: Bevacizumab is a humanized monoclonal antibody against vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF).
armGroupLabels: TQB2868 injection + Paclitaxel injection + Cisplatin/Carboplatin injection ± Bevacizumab injection

primaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of subjects who achieve a prespecified reduction in tumor volume and maintain the minimum time requirement, including complete response (CR) and partial response (PR).
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline to CR or PR ,about 12 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: The time between the first dose of medication and disease progression (PD) or death before PD; If there was no PD or death before PD, the date of the last imaging assessment was used as the cutoff date.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline up to PD or death, about 24 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of patients whose tumors shrink or remain stable for a certain period of time, including CR, PR, and stable disease (SD) cases.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline up to PD or death, about 24 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: It refers to the time between the first assessment of the tumor as CR or PR to PD or death before PD in subjects with CR or PR; If subjects with CR or PR did not present with PD or die before PD, the date of the last imaging assessment was used as the cutoff date.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline up to PD or death, about 24 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: The time from the first treatment to death from any cause.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline up to die, about 36 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of patients alive and free of disease progression from the beginning of the first treatment to 6 months.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline up to PD or death, about 24 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: Occurrence of all adverse events (AEs), serious adverse events (SAEs), treatment-related adverse events (TEAEs), and immune-related adverse events (IRaes).
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline to the end of the study, about 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.measure: European Organization for Research and Treatment of Cancer (EORTC) Quality of Life Questionnaire-C30 (QLQ -C30)
secondaryOutcomes.description: For questions 1 to 28, choose a number from 1 to 4, where 1 means no and 4 means very good. For questions 29 and 30, choose a number from 1 to 7, where 1 means very poor and 7 means very good.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline to the end of the study, about 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.measure: European Organization for Research and Treatment of Cancer (EORTC) Quality of Life Questionnaire (QLQ -CX24)
secondaryOutcomes.description: EORTC QLQ-CX24 is a questionnaire for measuring the quality of life of patients with cervical cancer. It has 24 items, including 3 multi-dimensional dimensions of symptoms, body image and sexual/vaginal function, and 6 single-dimensional dimensions of sexual activity, sexual enjoyment, sexual anxiety, lymphedema, menopausal symptoms and peripheral neuropathy. "None" to "very" were scored from 1 to 4, and the score was inversely proportional to the quality of life.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline to the end of the study, about 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: EQ-5D is a simple health measure developed by the European Society for Quality of Life. The EQ-5D mainly consists of two parts: the EQ-5D description system and the EQ-5D Visual Analogue Scale (EQ-VAS). The EQ-5D description system describes the health status in five dimensions: mobility, self-care, daily activities, pain/discomfort, and anxiety/depression. The EQ-VAS is to record the self-rated health status of the respondents. The scale is 0-100, with 0 being "worst imagined health" and 100 being "best imagined health."
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline to the end of the study, about 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: PD-1/TGF-β double antibody can increase Leukocyte differentiation antigen 8 (CD8+) T cells in the tumor, reduce immunosuppressive myeloid cells, and inhibit PD-1/PD-L1 pathway on the basis of targeting and neutralizing TGF-β in the tumor microenvironment, which can restore the activity of T cells, enhance the immune response, and more effectively improve the inhibition of tumor.
The relationship between human papillomavirus and cervical cancer is very close. Persistent infection of high-risk human papillomavirus is one of the high risk factors for cervical cancer.
